question: The Corruption Perceptions Index 2024, released by Transparency International in February 2025, ranked which country as the least corrupt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Denmark**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Denmark** has been ranked as the **least corrupt country** in the world according to the **Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2024**.
 
• The index was released by the global civil society organization **Transparency International** in **February 2025**.
 
• **Denmark** secured the **top position** with a score of **90 out of 100**, maintaining its reputation for high levels of public sector integrity and transparency.
 
• The **CPI 2024** ranks a total of **180 countries and territories** based on their perceived levels of **public sector corruption**.
 
• The ranking is determined by a scale where **0** indicates a country is **highly corrupt** and **100** indicates it is **very clean**.
